items.q: Bus was playing piano and he had a guy named Popeye on the sax, Luther West and Jesse Price and Had not was on bass... when I came in

ctx.x: Well, Bus Moten was playing piano,

Bus was playing piano and he had a guy named Popeye on the sax, Luther West and Jesse Price and Had not was on bass, Squonch Hall was on trumpet and Dee Stewart was on trumpet and when I came in, Had not recognized me right away.
